signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

profile.description: American business data center and cloud computing security company

bullets: Define and own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for advanced security workflows within the Insights platform.
Drive the product strategy for advanced threat detection and behavioral analysis capabilities tailored to modern security operations center (SOC) environments.
Partner closely with engineering leadership across multiple engineering teams to define requirements, prioritize features, and deliver capabilities through agile development…
Collaborate directly with field teams , customers, and strategic partners to gather operational workflow requirements and validate product-market fit.
Develop the innovation roadmap for advanced analytical models and AI/ML-assisted features that streamline security investigation and triage.
